Monologue: Pardon my intrusion, friend, but won't you mind waiting a little longer before closing?
We have much to speak of. Would be a shame to delay our inevitable meeting any longer.
I understand you are not much of a socialite, so I'll ask my questions and be on my way.
You wouldn't understand me the first time, but you have done yourself a great disservice, friend. Vulnerable people are the easiest to pick off.
But don't you worry. You have a new friend now. One you can't reject.
My research has been ruined by your choices. So let's find a new way we can help each other out. How does that sound, friend?
